svg.aria-label: Terminal — ami@sh:~$ intro: I build scalable backends, infra and agentic systems. Python, Go, Kubernetes, Kafka, LangGraph. ami@sh:~$ impact: backends — from 10 to 800 users in a week with zero downtime (AI stock-analysis agent backend); infra — mean time to first response cut by 90% with a self-healing Kubernetes operator across 75+ services; agents — up to +10 percentage points for open-source Qwen models on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, trained on trajectories from my agent harness.
